purpose: Defines the 4 decoupled evaluation grader engines and the multi-dimensional matrix evaluation and differential comparison engine for Prism.
scope: Covers crates/prism-grader: Grader trait, AssertionResult, RedGreenGrader, TrajectoryGrader, CircuitBreakerGrader, CalibratedJudge, MatrixResultDatum, MetricDifferential, and eval-report@1 schema formatting.
non_goals: Subprocess spawning or API networking (delegated to prism-core drivers).
CLI rendering or command dispatch (delegated to prism-cli).

api_surface.name: Grader
api_surface.signature: pub trait Grader: Send + Sync { fn name(&self) -> &'static str; fn evaluate(&self, spec: &TaskSpec, transcript: &CanonicalTranscript) -> Result<AssertionResult, EvaluationError>; }
api_surface.description: Assertion evaluation interface implemented by the four grading engines.
error_conditions: EvaluationError::TaskRunnerFailed if test suite fails execution
EvaluationError::AssertionFailed if an assertion is violated

api_surface.name: RedGreenGrader
api_surface.signature: pub struct RedGreenGrader; impl RedGreenGrader { pub async fn verify_transition(&self, sandbox: &WorkspaceSandbox) -> Result<AssertionResult, EvaluationError>; }
api_surface.description: Verifies that an injected bug or failing test caused the suite to FAIL initially (Red Pass) and that the agent's code made it PASS with zero regressions (Green Pass).
error_conditions: Fails if initial state passed or final state failed

api_surface.name: TrajectoryGrader
api_surface.signature: pub struct TrajectoryGrader { pub min_cache_hit_ratio: f32, pub max_circular_loops: usize }; impl Grader for TrajectoryGrader { ... }
api_surface.description: Grades the prompt cache hit percentage (threshold >= 90.0%) and asserts zero Tarjan SCC circular loops.

api_surface.name: CircuitBreakerGrader
api_surface.signature: pub struct CircuitBreakerGrader { pub max_allowed_rounds: usize }; impl Grader for CircuitBreakerGrader { ... }
api_surface.description: Asserts that multi-agent consensus iterations between reviewer pairs do not exceed 2 rounds.

api_surface.name: MatrixResultDatum
api_surface.signature: pub struct MatrixResultDatum { pub config_id: CompactString, pub model_name: CompactString, pub harness_name: CompactString, pub prompt_or_skill: CompactString, pub pass_rate: f64, pub cache_hit_ratio: f64, pub total_cost_usd: f64, pub turn_count: usize, pub turn_latency_p50_ms: u64, pub turn_latency_p95_ms: u64, pub total_wall_time_ms: u64, pub input_tokens: u64, pub output_tokens: u64, pub quality_score: f64, pub circular_loops_detected: usize }; impl MatrixResultDatum { pub fn from_execution(...) -> Self; }
api_surface.description: Comprehensive 8-dimensional evaluation metric record for a cell in the experiment matrix.

api_surface.name: MetricDifferential
api_surface.signature: pub struct MetricDifferential { pub candidate_id: CompactString, pub baseline_id: CompactString, pub delta_pass_rate_pct: f64, pub delta_cost_pct: f64, pub delta_turns_pct: f64, pub delta_cache_hit_pct: f64, pub delta_wall_time_pct: f64, pub delta_quality_pct: f64 }; impl MetricDifferential { pub fn compute(candidate: &MatrixResultDatum, baseline: &MatrixResultDatum) -> Self; }
api_surface.description: Data-vs-data differential calculating exact metric deltas between a candidate variant and a baseline control.

api_surface.name: build_eval_report
api_surface.signature: pub fn build_eval_report(eval_id: &str, task: &TaskSpec, transcript: &CanonicalTranscript, assertions: Vec<AssertionResult>) -> serde_json::Value
api_surface.description: Assembles the final scorecard into a JSON object strictly conforming to eval-report@1 schema.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WHEN RedGreenGrader evaluates a state transition, THE SYSTEM SHALL assert that the test runner fails before the patch and succeeds after the patch.
IF the test suite passes prior to patch application in a RedGreenGrader trial, THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the Red-to-Green assertion as FAILED with an InvalidRedState message.
WHEN TrajectoryGrader evaluates a transcript with a prompt cache hit ratio below min_cache_hit_ratio (default 0.90), THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the Cache Health assertion as FAILED.
WHEN TrajectoryGrader observes a CircularLoopAnomaly in the transcript, THE SYSTEM SHALL mark the Trajectory Integrity assertion as FAILED.
WHEN CircuitBreakerGrader evaluates review iterations between Drafter and Auditor, THE SYSTEM SHALL assert that total rounds are <= 2.

WHEN MatrixResultDatum::from_execution is invoked, THE SYSTEM SHALL calculate all 8 dimensions (Pass rate, cache hit %, cost, turns, latency p50/p95, wall time, input/output tokens, and composite quality score).
WHEN MetricDifferential::compute is invoked, THE SYSTEM SHALL compute exact empirical percentage deltas between candidate and baseline.
WHEN build_eval_report generates output, THE SYSTEM SHALL validate that the resulting JSON payload validates 100% against the eval-report@1 JSON Schema.

reasoning: Specifies the 4 decoupled evaluation grader engines, the 8-dimensional matrix metrics, and data-vs-data differential calculations.
